answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a vault of work-bonded reputation: a new identity's earning power stays locked in the vault until peers attest real completed work, so a fake cannot buy trust — it must earn it task by task, each attestation costing the attestor reputation if the work proves fake. A comet of a thousand cheap identities burns out fast: each starts sable-dark with zero credit, and no established counterparty trades with it until someone stakes reputation on it.
